pit.no_lookahead_checks: Passed: delisted symbol (ABR.PRA 2021-06-23) eligible at 2019-01-01 and 2020-06-01, not eligible at 2022-01-01
pit.listing_termination_handling: valid_from/valid_to per entity, PIT snapshot at date T includes only entities where valid_from <= T <= valid_to
pit.rename_handling: FB->META single entity via stable asset ID fc6a5dcd..., no double-count, bars continuous via asof
pit.terminal_position_semantics: Stale last_price persists indefinitely if liquidate_at_end=False; only liquidated at last bar's close if liquidate_at_end=True; last close not recoverable after delisting - documented as limitation, no invented -100%

verdict_note: Dataset is materially more survivorship-aware (84.1% survivors vs 99.9%, +224 delisted histories, yearly exits now visible, PIT no-lookahead passes, terminal behavior audited). It is a survivorship-aware reconstructed universe, not a fully point-in-time verified universe (TIER_A coverage insufficient for 'fully PIT' claim). V3 old vs new shows -19.7pp return, -0.052 Sharpe, indicating prior performance was optimistic. No strategy tuning, no V4, PAPER unchanged, LIVE disabled.
next_steps: For a fully PIT dataset, need authoritative delisting event source or larger inactive probe (full 2863, not just 300 sample) and more rename chains. Current dataset is valid for survivorship sensitivity analysis.
